note: §8.1's golden set: 45 questions, 15 per router class. Gold is named by (rel_path, qualified_name) and resolved to UIDs at run time — a UID is a truncated sha1 over repo_id and is unreviewable in a diff. Recall is measured against PACKED context, not retrieved candidates: §8.1 is explicit that 'a gold node retrieved and then dropped by the packer never reached the model'. Each question carries a reference answer split into sentences, with `claims` marking which of them §6.1 counts as claim sentences — that is what makes the T2 classifier's precision and recall measurable rather than assumed.

composition.TRACE: 8 Python, 7 TS/TSX — ≥3 TS on App Router GET/POST handlers

questions.query: what calls audit_event
reference: `audit_event` is called from the auth views, the auth services and the billing views.
It emits one structured log line per call.

questions.query: who calls charge_card
reference: `SubscriptionView.post` calls `charge_card` [C1].
`run_monthly_billing` also calls it for each active subscription [C2].

questions.query: callers of constant_time_equals
reference: `verify_credentials` is the only caller of `constant_time_equals`.

questions.query: where is chunked used
reference: `run_monthly_billing` uses `chunked` to batch active subscriptions.

questions.query: what does LoginView.post call
reference: `LoginView.post` calls `verify_credentials`, `issue_token` and `audit_event`.

questions.query: where is issue_token defined
reference: `issue_token` is defined in `authx.services`.

questions.query: subclasses of TimestampMixin
reference: `User`, `ApiToken`, `Plan` and `Subscription` all extend `TimestampMixin`.

questions.query: what imports common.utils
reference: The auth views, auth services, billing views and billing tasks all import `common.utils`.

questions.query: which view handles the login route
reference: The `login` route dispatches to `LoginView`.

questions.query: usages of ApiToken
reference: `ApiToken` is used by `issue_token`, `revoke_all` and `TokenRevokeView.delete`.

questions.query: what calls mask_email
reference: `LoginView.post` calls `mask_email` when a login fails.

questions.query: where is Subscription defined
reference: `Subscription` is defined in `billing.models`.

questions.query: what does run_monthly_billing call
reference: `run_monthly_billing` calls `chunked` and `charge_card`.

questions.query: callers of soft_delete
reference: `Subscription.cancel` calls `soft_delete`.

questions.query: what calls revoke
reference: `revoke_all` and `TokenRevokeView.delete` both call `revoke`.

questions.query: how are API tokens issued
reference: Tokens are minted by `issue_token`, which generates a hex secret and stores it [C1].
An audit event is emitted for every issued token [C1].

questions.query: how does login work
reference: `LoginView.post` validates the payload and then calls `verify_credentials` [C1].
On success it issues a token and returns 201 [C1].
Which client consumes that token?

questions.query: what charges a customer card
reference: `charge_card` performs the charge and returns whether it succeeded [C1].
It returns early for non-positive amounts [C1].

questions.query: how are emails masked in logs
reference: `mask_email` reduces an address to its first character plus the domain [C1].

questions.query: how does monthly billing run
reference: `run_monthly_billing` batches active subscriptions and charges each one [C1].

questions.query: how is a subscription total computed
reference: `monthly_total` returns the plan price when the subscription is active, and zero otherwise [C1].

questions.query: how does soft deletion work
reference: `soft_delete` stamps `deleted_at` rather than removing the row [C1].
`is_deleted` reports the result [C1].

questions.query: how is the database url configured
reference: `database_url` reads `DATABASE_URL` and falls back to a local sqlite file [C1].

questions.query: how are passwords compared safely
reference: `constant_time_equals` wraps `hmac.compare_digest` so comparison time does not leak length [C1].

questions.query: what does the token revoke endpoint do
reference: `TokenRevokeView.delete` looks the token up for the current user and revokes it [C1].
It returns 404 when no such token exists [C1].

questions.query: how are created and updated times tracked
reference: `TimestampMixin` adds `created_at` and `updated_at` columns to any model that extends it [C1].

questions.query: how is a display name chosen for a user
reference: `display_name` prefers the full name and falls back to the local part of the email [C1].

questions.query: how is a list split into batches
reference: `chunked` yields successive slices of at most the requested size [C1].

questions.query: what happens to clock skew on windows
reference: `clock_skew_seconds` is defined twice under a platform guard, and returns zero on Windows [C1].
It might behave differently on other platforms.

questions.query: how are all of a user's tokens revoked at once
reference: `revoke_all` iterates the user's active tokens and revokes each one [C1].
It returns the number revoked [C1].
